name: sos-sales-api
description: Sistema Operacional de Continuidade Comercial e Navegação de Vendas

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts && tsup scripts/reconcile-cakto-subscriptions.ts --format esm --out-dir dist && node scripts/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:lab: APP_ENV=lab tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts && APP_ENV=lab tsup scripts/reconcile-cakto-subscriptions.ts --format esm --out-dir dist && APP_ENV=lab node scripts/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:prod: APP_ENV=production tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts && APP_ENV=production tsup scripts/reconcile-cakto-subscriptions.ts --format esm --out-dir dist && APP_ENV=production node scripts/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.infra:up: npx supabase start && docker compose up -d sos-redis
scripts.infra:down: npx supabase stop && docker compose down
scripts.check:fresh: npm run db:reset && npm run db:wait && npm run check
scripts.test:integration: APP_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:55432/postgres} vitest run tests/integration --no-file-parallelism --test-timeout=20000 && node scripts/cleanup-test-fixtures.mjs

author: MCT LTDA
